messages.content: Help me create a term query for a field type `usernameField` that searches for the value 'JohnDoe' in a case-insensitive manner within an Elasticsearch test case?

function.name: TermQueryBuilderTests_termQuery
function.description: Constructs a term query based on the provided field type, value, and case sensitivity setting. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

mapper.description: The MappedFieldType instance for the field to be queried. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

value.description: The value to query for. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

caseInsensitive.description: Whether the term query should be case insensitive. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.
